testcase.name: storage failures return false and do not mutate bookmarks or start a clock
suggestion factory checks the original instant against its stated local start before rounding
nonstandard JSON and oversized payloads are rejected without throwing
wrong preference type and invalid saves preserve unrelated settings
restoring after midnight preserves the stored date instead of rebinding it
invalid date zone identity and source relationships are rejected
manual context captures the parish date rather than UTC or the phone date
published start must fall on its stored local date and personal start must use a whole minute
a persisted ambiguous DST occurrence cannot bypass the schedule restriction
all sources round trip with the accepted date and zone
numbers booleans missing duplicate and unknown fields never become a context
